description: One round of a brain on the brief of a fix run. The tree of an accepted report is in the working tree of the checkout, uncommitted and not measured.

run_id.description: The run the round belongs to.

round.description: The number of the round in the run, counted across every round of it.

submission.description: What the brain handed over: a fix report, or a question for a person.

submission_path.description: The submission file of the round, as an absolute path.

question.description: The question, when the brain asked one, else null.

root_cause.description: The analysis so far, when the brain gave it.

apply.description: What was applied to the checkout, or null when the round asked a question and nothing was, and for a round that a process in a box ran: the host applies the tree of the box.

written.description: Files written to the checkout: new, changed in content or mode, or links made again.

deleted.description: Files of the checkout that the box's tree no longer had.

ignored.description: Files of the box's tree left out: under .git/ or .agent-fox/, ignored by the checkout's git rules, or no file or link.

submitted.description: True when the brain handed over a submission that was accepted: the host that runs af fix run in a box reads it from the result.
